title: Finding
description: A structured audit conclusion submitted by a policy (A-003, §15.1, §15.2).
provisional_reason: Derived from the TwinLedger v3.0 master technical specification. The organizer contract is not archived in this repository, therefore this schema is PROVISIONAL and isolated behind adapter/ (see docs/ASSUMPTIONS.json).

affected_ids.description: Exact canonical set of records that carry the anomaly. Order is not significant; the matcher canonicalizes and de-duplicates (REQ-SCORE-002).

claimed_amount.description: Claimed anomalous amount in minor units of `currency` (absolute value semantics are defined by scoring/match config).

evidence_ids.description: Public record IDs that prove the finding. Must contain one complete admissible evidence set; must be reachable through public tools (REQ-VER-010).

explanation.description: Free text. Never influences the base reward (15.2, Anti-goal: eloquence is not scored).
